name: Tombs
description: A cheerfully morbid graveyard gravedigger, a man in his seventies with a warm twinkle, who sings murder ballads and old Appalachian songs.
build: Wiry and a little stooped with rounded shoulders, a small pot belly, and thin arms and legs of ordinary human proportion, standing on slightly bowed legs.
face: Weathered ruddy pale skin, bright blue eyes under big bushy white eyebrows, a big red bulbous nose, deep smile lines, and a thick white walrus moustache over a wide mouth.
hair: Short wispy white hair at the sides under a brown tweed flat cap.
outfit: A brown tweed flat cap; a faded olive-green wool waistcoat over a collarless off-white work shirt, sleeves rolled to the elbows so both forearms and hands are bare; brown corduroy trousers held up by bold red braces; heavy brown leather work boots caked in dark mud to the ankle.
performance_style: Easy and stooped: feet apart, weight on the character-left boot. Both arms hang loose at his sides, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty, fingers visible beside the thighs. Head tilted forward, a cheerful knowing look.
location: An old hillside graveyard at dusk: leaning mossy headstones, a wrought-iron gate, a mound of fresh earth, a bare crooked oak and a lantern on a stone wall, with grassy ground running to the bottom of the frame.
recognition_cues: a thick white walrus moustache and bushy white brows
bold red braces over an off-white shirt
heavy brown work boots caked in dark mud
avoid: a shovel or spade in the key art

sing.intent: Murder-ballad vocal loop: mic at the mouth in the character-right hand, the character-left hand lifted open to the side as he tells the tale, a slow sway on the bowed legs, a wink between lines, then return to the easy stance. The mouth must visibly open wide and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing; the mic stays in the character-right hand.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: the bushy brows shoot up, both open hands rise to the chest, then he chuckles. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: tug the flat cap down with the character-left hand, the character-right forearm across the waistcoat, and hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: amble in with a bow-legged gait, tip the flat cap with the character-left hand, and settle into the easy stance.
